paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Jordan lui khen suahlam a om Amorte kumpipa tengteng leh tuipi gei a om Kanaan gam kumpipa tengtengte'n, agalkah masiah uh TOUPA'N Jordan tuite Israel suante ma ah akangtatsak, chih ana zak un, Israel suante ziak in alungtang uh ana zul khin a, lauthawng lou himhim a-om kei uhi.
heading: Gilgal A Zeksumna

paite: Huai lai in TOUPA'N Joshua kiang ah, "Temta hiam kibawl inla, Israel suante zek anihveina ding in sumsak in," achi hi.
Joshua in temta hiamte akibawl a, Israel suante Gibeth Haraloth ah azek uh asumsak hi.
Joshua in azeksumna ziak hiai ahi: Aigupta gam a pan pawt tengteng, pasal galdoumi tengteng Aigupta gam a pan apawtkhiak nung un lamkal a gamdai a asih khit tak ziak uh ahi.
Aigupta gam a pan pawt tengteng zeksumsa vek ahi ua; himahleh Aigupta gam a pan apawt ua gamdai a lamkal a piang tengteng bel zeksum ahi kei uhi.

TOUPA aw angaihkhiak nop louh ziak ua mipi tengteng, Aigupta gam a pan hong pawt galdou mite tan hihman a a-om vek tan un Israel suante gamdai ah kum sawmli avialvak uhi. TOUPA'N amau pi-le-pute kiang a nawitui leh khuaizu luanna gam kichiam a piak ana chiam, huai gam mu lou ding in akiang uah TOUPA ana kichiamta hi.
Asuante uh amau sik a akhanletsakte Joshua in azek uh asumsak hi. Lamkal a azek uh sum ahih louh ziak in zeksum louh ana hi him uhi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, mipi tengteng zek asum khit un, adam mateng uh amau giahphual chiat uah a-om uhi.
TOUPA'N Joshua kiang ah, "Tuni in Aiguptate'n nou hon muhsitna uh noumau a pan ka khukmangta," achi hi. Huchi in tuni tan in huai mun Gilgal achi uhi.
Israel suante'n Gilgal ah giahphual asat ua; Jeriko Phaizang ah huai kha, ani sawm-le-li ni in Paikan Ankuang alui uhi.
Paikan khit azing mah in huai gam a tanghou silngou soh louh leh vaimim kan ane uhi.
Huai gam a buh anek ni zing ua pan manna aketa kei a; Israel suante'n manna leng amu nawn kei uhi. Huai kum in Kanaan gam a buh-le-bal ane zawta uhi.

Huan Jeriko kho kiangchin a Joshua a-om lai in adak a, a-entou a, ngai in, hichi ahong hi a, amazawn chin ah mi khat anamsau phawisa tawi in ana ding hi. Joshua in ava naih a, akiang ah, "Kou lam a pang na hi hia, ka melmate uh lam a pang?" achi hi.
heading: Joshua Leh Namsau Tawi Pasal Khat

paite: Ama'n, “Hilou e, TOUPA sepaihte heutu dia hong pai ka hi zaw," achi hi. Huchi in lei ah Joshua abokkhup a, amah abia a, akiang ah, "Ka toupa'n asikha kiang ah bang gen ding nei ahia?" achi hi.
TOUPA sepaihte heutu in Joshua kiang ah, "Na khepek a pan na khedap phel in. Na dinna mun siangthou ahi,” achi a; huchi in Joshua in aphelta hi.
